summary: Workplace for desk-based work. Variants: cellular (cellkontor), open-plan (kontorslandskap) and activity-based (aktivitetsbaserat kontor, ABW). Swedish law (AFS 2023:12, in force 1 Jan 2025, replacing AFS 2020:1) requires the staff functions (WC, eating, pause, rest, clothes storage, drinking water), outdoor air of 7 l/s per person + 0.35 l/s per m2, and daylight and view, but sets almost no room sizes. Size benchmarks come from state office policy (15 m2 per employee) rather than law.

regulatory.bbr_verksamhetsklass: 1 — BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 10 § names 'kontor' explicitly (people with good knowledge of the premises, able to evacuate themselves, awake). BFS 2024:7 replaced BBR section 5 from 1 Jul 2025; the transition period allowing BBR ended 30 Jun 2026.

permits: Usually none if the building is already office; otherwise bygglov for change of use, PBL 9 kap. 15 § 1 since 2025-12-01 (formerly 9 kap. 2 § 3 a) — see cross_cutting.json cou_bygglov_trigger.
Detaljplan must allow Kontor (K) or Centrum (C) — see Boverket PBL kunskapsbanken on användning av kvartersmark.
Anmälan (PBF 6 kap. 1 §, see cross_cutting.json cou_anmalan) for new/changed ventilation, VA installations or fire-safety-relevant changes.
regulatory.operator_oversight: Arbetsmiljöverket (work environment); kommunens byggnadsnämnd (building permits, OVK)

gross_m2_per_unit.source: Riksrevisionen RiR 2025:17 'Kostsam kvadratjakt' sect. 4.1.1–4.1.2: state office agencies averaged 22 m2 office area per employee in 2023 (28 in 2014); 15 m2 per employee used as reference (upper limit of agency strategies; Skatteverket targets 12–14 m2). Regeringens skrivelse 2025/26:65 sect. 3.1 finds 15 m2 per employee a reasonable starting point. Area includes workstations, support areas, WC, meeting and conference rooms.
gross_m2_per_unit.note: Measured per employee, not per desk. For ABW, desks are often provisioned for ~75 % of staff (CAMM faktablad, p. 3), so m2 per desk is higher than m2 per employee.

staff_per_unit.source: Occupants are the staff; desk-sharing ratio is the relevant parameter (ABW ~0.75 desks per employee, CAMM faktablad p. 3).

egress_design_density.source: BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 4 §: design occupancy = maximum number of persons expected given intended use and room size; default densities are given only for affärslokal (0.5), pub/bar (3) and samlingslokal (2.5 persons/m2), none for offices. Use the furnished workplace count plus meeting-room seats.

occupancy.hourly_presence_note: Modelling assumption (indicative). Peak ~0.7 of staff present follows CAMM faktablad p. 3 ('cirka 70 procent av arbetskraften i genomsnitt befinner sig på kontoret en vanlig dag'); hourly shape is not sourced. Weekend ~0.

required.basis: AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 5 § — workplaces shall have sufficient area and free height for the activity; 3 kap. 6 § sufficient freedom of movement.

size.count: number of workplaces (ABW: ~0.75 x employees per CAMM faktablad p. 3)
size.source: AFS 2023:12 sets no m2 per workplace (functional requirement only). Whole-office benchmark see occupancy.gross_m2_per_unit.

spaces.shareable_note: Desks can be shared with coworking members or other tenants outside the tenant's core hours.
spaces.notes: Ceiling height: AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 5 § allmänna råd — room height should be at least 2.40 m (2.70 m in rooms for many persons, e.g. teaching; locally 2.10 m where standing height is needed). Daylight and view: AFS 2023:12 5 kap. 25 § (law) — workplaces shall give satisfactory daylight and view during the working day; if not reasonable, compensating measures; allmänna råd points to SS-EN 17037:2018 for assessment methods. BFS 2024:8 4 kap. 3 § also requires rooms in lokaler where people stay more than temporarily to have sufficient daylight and view. No numeric daylight factor is set for offices in either text (the 2 % in space_requirements.json is not a legal value).

required.basis: AFS 2023:12 5 kap. 4 § — indoor workplaces shall normally be supplied with at least 7 l/s outdoor air per person plus at least 0.35 l/s per m2 floor area during working hours; allmänna råd: 7 l/s applies to sedentary work, higher activity may need more. 5 kap. 3 § allmänna råd: air-change effectiveness should be at least 40 %.

size.count: airflow l/s = 7 x persons + 0.35 x m2 floor area
size.source: AFS 2023:12 5 kap. 4 § (verified against PDF p. 39). BFS 2024:8 3 kap. 4–5 §§ give only functional requirements for lokaler (numeric values only for dwellings).

spaces.notes: Densification (e.g. ABW, coworking) raises per-person airflow demand; small enclosed rooms (focus rooms, phone booths, meeting rooms) are where retrofit ventilation typically fails. Plant-room area is not regulated.

required.basis: Not required by law; standard part of office programmes.

size.source: No Swedish public source found for m2 per meeting seat.

spaces.shareable_note: Bookable by other tenants or coworking members.
spaces.notes: Rooms for larger groups: AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 5 § allmänna råd suggests 2.70 m room height for rooms intended for many persons. A conference room for >150 persons would be verksamhetsklass 2B (BFS 2024:7 2 kap. 12 §). Hearing loop: BFS 2024:12 3 kap. 6 § requires sound transfer to hearing aids in samlingssalar and receptions in publika lokaler (new build).

required.basis: AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 2 § — workplaces shall have the rooms needed for the activity; allmänna råd names 'tysta rum' as an example.

size.count: need-based; more critical in open-plan and ABW
size.source: No size or ratio in AFS 2023:12.

spaces.notes: If used as a permanent workplace the daylight/view requirement (AFS 2023:12 5 kap. 25 §) applies; short-term focus rooms are usually treated as temporary-use rooms (assessment, not stated in the text).

required.basis: AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 60 § — employees shall be able to eat in suitable rooms with tables and chairs with backrests (also those eating brought food); 61 § — near the place where brought food is eaten there shall be a refrigerator, means to heat food and to wash dishes. 36 § — drinking water near workplaces and eating areas.

size.count: seats for those eating simultaneously (3 kap. 38 §: sized to number normally using it at the same time)

spaces.shareable_note: Allmänna råd to 3 kap. 60 § names a restaurant as an example of a suitable eating place — a staff restaurant or nearby restaurant can partly substitute, but 61 § still requires fridge/heating/dishwashing near where brought food is eaten.
spaces.notes: Must not connect directly to a WC (3 kap. 57 §). daylight_required here reflects that it is a room where people stay more than temporarily (BFS 2024:8 4 kap. 3 §); AFS does not specifically require daylight in eating rooms beyond 5 kap. 25 §.

required.basis: AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 62 § — place for pauses with possibility for short recovery and enough seats with backrests.

spaces.shareable_note: Usually combined with the eating room.

required.basis: AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 63 § — there shall be, or be quickly arrangeable, a suitable rest space for temporary, undisturbed, lying rest. Allmänna råd: a separate vilrum may be needed when more than 50 persons are employed simultaneously in the same area; a WC should be nearby.

size.count: 1 (dedicated room typically when >50 simultaneously employed — guidance)

spaces.shareable_note: Can be shared between tenants in a multi-tenant building if easily accessible.

required.basis: AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 56 § sufficient WCs and washbasins near workplaces/pause rooms; 57 § sufficiently large, separate, lockable, washbasin, no direct connection to eating room; 58 § accessible WCs at existing workplaces for those who need them; 3 kap. 4 § p. 6 — when designing new build/ombyggnad at least one accessible WC per storey.

size.count: 1 WC per started 15 employees (allmänna råd to 3 kap. 56 §); at least one accessible WC per storey at new build/ombyggnad (3 kap. 4 §)
size.source: AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 58 § allmänna råd: an accessible toilet should be at least 2.2 x 2.2 m (= 4.84 m2), larger if assistants/aids needed; alarm recommended. Ordinary WC size not given.

spaces.notes: value_m2 refers to the accessible WC only.

required.basis: AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 40 § storage for private clothes for all who need it at the same time; 41 § lockable storage for personal valuables.

spaces.notes: In ABW typically lockers. Changing rooms (3 kap. 46 §) are required only for dirty/sweaty work or special work clothes — normally not for office work; showers/changing for cycling commuters are practice, not law.

required.basis: AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 2 § allmänna råd names spaces for property maintenance and service as examples of rooms that may be needed.

AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 7 § — processes with particular risk normally in separate room; allmänna råd names copying machines (and fans, charging batteries, dishwashers) as examples that may need a separate room.
BFS 2024:8 11 kap. 1–3 §§ — waste shall be manageable in or next to the building; waste devices or waste rooms located, designed and dimensioned for hygiene and collection.

size.source: BFS 2024:8 has no m2; municipal waste regulations (renhållningsföreskrifter) set collection conditions.

required.basis: Not required by law; accessible main entrance required for new build (BFS 2024:12 2 kap. 1 §).

spaces.notes: If the reception is a publik lokal, BFS 2024:12 3 kap. 6 § requires sound transfer to hearing aids (new build).

variants.label: Cellular office (cellkontor)
variants.changes: One or two persons per room; every room is a permanent workplace needing daylight/view and ventilation; drives facade length per person and limits plan depth. Highest m2 per employee.

variants.label: Open-plan (kontorslandskap)
variants.changes: Fixed desks in open areas; deep plans possible but daylight/view still required (AFS 2023:12 5 kap. 25 §); acoustics and quiet rooms (3 kap. 2 § allmänna råd) become critical.

variants.label: Activity-based (aktivitetsbaserat kontor)
variants.changes: No personal desks; typically ~75 % desks per employee (CAMM faktablad p. 3); more meeting, quiet and phone rooms; lockers replace personal storage (3 kap. 40–41 §§). Riksrevisionen RiR 2025:17 sect. 2.3 notes agencies converting to ABW reduced area substantially.

typical_blockers: Not applicable as a conversion target from office; relevant when re-using older office stock: low outdoor-air capacity versus 7 l/s/person + 0.35 l/s/m2 at higher densities.
Deep plans failing daylight and view for permanent workplaces (AFS 2023:12 5 kap. 25 §).
Missing accessible WC per storey at ombyggnad (AFS 2023:12 3 kap. 4 § p. 6).
typical_enablers: Same verksamhetsklass 1; no change of use permit needed.
ABW raises utilisation, freeing floors for other uses.

open_questions: No Swedish private-sector public benchmark for m2 per workplace was found (Fabege/Vasakronan/Castellum/CBRE do not publish it as a key figure); 15 m2/employee is the state benchmark. Verify against a commercial source if needed.
Hourly presence shape is a modelling assumption; post-2020 attendance may be well below 70 % on Mondays/Fridays.
AFS 2023:12 sets no numeric daylight factor; decide whether the platform should test against SS-EN 17037 levels (referenced only as method in allmänna råd).
BFS 2024:8 3 kap. has no numeric airflow for lokaler; confirm no Boverket allmänna råd or vägledning adds one.
